description: Stage 4 / CODEX P0.1: Trick Room's WRITE side (Cresselia's onSwitchIn sets battleConfig's private trickRoom flag) is an unaffected side effect, but the READ side (`isTrickRoom()`, called at the turn-order site) is itself a generic hook -- merged, its return is always discarded, so `Bcp = () => trickRoomChallenge || (merged.isTrickRoom() truthy)` collapses to just `trickRoomChallenge` (false here). A merged Trick Room is therefore functionally INERT for turn order: the faster Pokemon (Jolteon, speed 130) still moves first, even though Cresselia's ability 'is active'. An unfixed engine that reads battle_config.trick_room directly (bypassing the discarded-hook layer) would incorrectly reverse turn order instead.
